bullets.title: MU: Bull consensus ahead of Jun 24 earnings; $1200 PT on 200%+ DRAM ASP surge
bullets.body: Citi raises MU PT to $1200 (10x CY27 EPS) on DRAM spot up 52% since January, 21% above contract pricing, and 5% undersupply forecast through 2026. GS models F3Q revs ~$48.7B/EPS ~$29.95 vs street $23.70 — 20%+ above consensus. JPMorgan notes memory as most crowded tech long with 75% of buyside expecting additional Strategic Customer Agreements at earnings; street consensus EPS $20.57, revenue $35.56B for Jun 24 print.

bullets.title: WDC/STX: HDD pricing cycle extending through CY28; EPS estimates 70%+ above consensus
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises WDC PT to $650 and STX PT to $1,035 after Asia checks confirm nearline HDD pricing targeting $25-30/TB from current <$15/TB, with demand growing 40-50% annually vs supply 30-35%. WDC up 32.6% on the week (+333% YTD), STX up 27%; vendors signing LTAs through 2032 with hyperscalers prioritizing storage over compute.

bullets.title: ACN crashes 18-25% on FY27 organic growth guide cut; William Blair, MS downgrade
bullets.body: Accenture F3Q revenue $18.72B missed; bookings -3% cc YoY; FY26 guidance narrowed to +3-4% (from +3-5%); large managed services deals ($300-500M) slipped to FY27. Morgan Stanley cut to EW at $177 from $240 citing AI spend crowding out traditional IT services; William Blair to market perform. JPM maintains OW but cuts FY27 PT to $179. Street now modeling negative FY27 organic growth. ACN down 24.8% on the week, -52% YTD.

bullets.title: FOXA acquires ROKU for $160/share ($22B); ROKU gets 8 analyst downgrades
bullets.body: Fox agreed to acquire Roku for $160/share (60% cash/$96 + 40% stock/0.9693 FOXA shares), implying ~$22B EV. Deal expected to close H1 2027 with $400M cost synergies; combined company becomes 3rd largest US TV player. FOXA fell 17% on deal announcement; ROKU was downgraded to neutral/market perform at JPM, Wolfe, Piper Sandler, Evercore, Susquehanna, Citizens, Loop, William Blair, and Oppenheimer. Netflix denied interest in Lionsgate or Roku.

bullets.title: INTC +10% on Trump-Apple chip manufacturing announcement; 18A-P enters risk production
bullets.body: Trump announced Apple agreed to work with Intel to design and manufacture chips in the US, driving INTC +10.6%. Intel simultaneously confirmed 18A-P entered risk production with 9% better performance or 18% lower power vs 18A. Analysts view deal as potential ~$1-1.2B annually (5% of TSMC's Apple business). Samsung Foundry also gaining chip orders from Google (Axion ARM 2028), AMD (future CPUs), Tesla (AI6).

bullets.title: AAPL raising prices on memory cost crisis; iPhone 18 ASP increase ~$50 per JPM
bullets.body: Apple CEO Tim Cook confirmed price increases are 'unavoidable' as memory/storage costs surged 80-90% YTD, triple digits YoY; hyperscalers consuming 50%+ of DRAM/NAND supply push Apple to back of queue. JPM estimates modest ~$50 iPhone 18 ASP increase (vs press estimates of $200+), citing $40 component savings and $15 offset from in-house modem. Foldable iPhone launch Fall 2026 at ~$2,000+ with ~6M units.

bullets.title: AVGO: JPM and Wolfe bullish on secured 4-generation TPU deal; 2027 AI revenue 2-2.5x
bullets.body: JPM's Harlan Sur defends AVGO: TPU v8i 3nm 'Sunfish' fully qualified and ramping with 18+ month lead over Google's competing MediaTek design; TPU v9 2nm on-track for CY28. GOOGL/AVGO 5-year agreement through TPU v11 with commitments to increase revenues annually through 2031. Wolfe notes XPV financing backstop risk ($29B) is low probability but if successful, 20-25GW FY28 implies $250-300B XPU revenue. AVGO also backing $35B Anthropic AI chip order.

bullets.title: MRVL: 13 consecutive weeks up; KeyBanc raises PT to $385 on DC networking TAM
bullets.body: KeyBanc raises MRVL PT to $385 (from $260) based on 37x FY29 EPS of $10.31 vs consensus $8.89. Sees DC networking as ~$30B ex-NVDA TAM by 2030 with $20B optical, $10B switching. Scale-up (SU) networking more durable than custom XPUs; MRVL custom XPUs expected $10B by FY29. MRVL also planning TSMC 1.4nm for next-gen AI connectivity chips.

bullets.title: CRM: 13+ consecutive down days, -27% over period; Fin acquisition $3.6B for AI agent
bullets.body: CRM set longest losing streak on record per GS desk. Salesforce acquired Fin (formerly Intercom) for $3.6B in cash (~9x trailing ARR); Fin AI Agent resolves 76% of support volume at $100M+ ARR growing 350% YoY. Wolfe maintains Outperform; deal validates Agentforce strategy and fills fast-deploy gap. Monness upgraded CRM to Buy with $200 PT.

bullets.title: CRDO/SITM/CRWV: AI infrastructure adjacencies with strong conference takeaways
bullets.body: Roth maintains Buy on CRDO ($300 PT) after London Conference: AEC cabling ramping across multiple customers with robust demand, optical business targeting $600M+ revenue this fiscal year. SITM Buy at $900 PT: Elite 2 Super-TCXO sampling 2H26 for AI GPU cluster sync, improving utilization from sub-50%. CRWV capacity raised to 1.9GW for CY26; Nasdaq 100 inclusion June 22.

bullets.title: NVDA: Raises $25B in investment-grade bonds; Vera Rubin 10x tokens/MW vs GB200
bullets.body: NVIDIA announced $25B corporate bond sale (first since 2021) and $80B buyback with dividend raised from $0.01 to $0.25. Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers 10x more tokens per megawatt than GB200 and one-tenth cost per million tokens for inference. NVDA also gaining inference market share to 74% from 66%. NVDA, TSLA, MU carry largest single-name short gamma in US market per MS QDS.

bullets.title: AMD: Citi upgrades to Buy at $575 on Meta MI450 GPU custom wins; 30MW Rackspace deal
bullets.body: Citi's Atif Malik upgraded AMD to Buy with $575 target on META MI450 GPU custom chip wins providing lower TCO vs merchant products, estimating $15B TAM per gigawatt. AMD signed definitive 30 MW AI compute deal with Rackspace (AMD Instinct MI355X, EPYC CPUs) for regulated enterprise workloads from late 2026 through 2028.

bullets.title: TLN: GS initiates Buy; FERC approves data center grid connectivity plan; TLN up 21% on week
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs initiated Talen Energy (TLN) at Buy with $499 PT — AWS PPA de-risks cash flows, PJM capacity prices support structural tailwinds. TLN completed $3.45B acquisition of PJM natural gas assets from Energy Capital Partners. FERC unanimously approved Trump plan to accelerate AI data center grid connections. TLN up 21% on the week, +16.4% YTD.

bullets.title: SNAP: $2,195 SPECS AR glasses unveiled; analysts cautious on form factor and price
bullets.body: Snap launched SPECS AR glasses at $2,195 (51° FOV, 4-hour battery, 450K+ developer target) for Fall 2026. Citi maintains Neutral noting multiple generations needed for mass adoption. META Ray-Bans cited as competitive advantage at $224-$799. SPECS development estimated at $3.5B with $500M annual cash burn.

bullets.title: SHOP: Spring 2026 Editions highlight AI commerce momentum; JPM OW at $150
bullets.body: JPM maintains OW on SHOP with $150 PT after Spring Editions showcase: AI-powered Catalog converting 2x higher vs scraped data, Shop Pay expanding to non-SHOP brands (250M+ shoppers), Campaign Autopilot across FB/IG/ChatGPT. Management indicates high-20/30%+ growth while holding headcount flat through AI productivity. Oppenheimer maintains Outperform at $175 PT validating AI-first positioning.

bullets.title: DKNG: Prediction market momentum but NY/NJ sports betting GGR weak on World Cup holds
bullets.body: DraftKings Predictions recorded biggest weekend ever with 200%+ customer growth and $4B annualized volume. However, NY 2Q GGR tracking -23% YoY with handle -1%, market share down from 35% to 33%. NJ May sports betting GGR -24% YoY. Negative holds driven by NY Knicks and World Cup USA victory. Fanatics only sportsbook with positive 2QTD GGR (+4% YoY).

bullets.title: META: $15B Alexander Wang hire reported; exploring equity raise of tens of billions
bullets.body: Meta Threads reached 500M MAUs. META exploring external capital structures (bond JVs, sovereign wealth) and considering tens of billions equity raise. China's NDRC blocked Meta's $2B Manus acquisition; Manus's Chinese backers planning to re-acquire at same price. META morale near all-time lows following mass layoffs. Meta also in talks to sell custom AI chips and secured 1.6GW AI compute from Crusoe.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $50/watt GPU rental deal bullish for GCP growth; UK CMA imposes search requirements
bullets.body: Google renting ~110K NVDA GB300 GPUs at ~$50/watt annually — MS sees upside to 27%/16% GCP/AWS growth if monetized at $25/watt. UK CMA imposed conduct requirements for fairer search ranking and user data portability. Google losing key AI researcher Noam Shazeer to OpenAI. Waymo recalled 3,800+ robotaxis over construction zone software flaw.

bullets.title: CCL: Citi raises estimates on lower fuel from Iran deal; 2Q net yield +2.5% vs 2% guide
bullets.body: Citi raises CCL FY26 EPS by $0.23 to $2.43 on marine gasoil down 13-18% since last reports. 85% inventory booked with customer deposits +9%; onboard spend/ALBD up ~10% last two quarters with guide closer to mid-single digits. Mizuho analyst would own CCL stock into Q2 earnings. CCL reports June 23.

bullets.title: AMZN: AWS FY27 revenue growth projected +37% on agentic AI; FTC lawsuit risk on advertisers
bullets.body: Citi bullish after AWS Summit: AWS Bedrock AgentCore agent task volume up 15x in six months; projects AWS FY27 acceleration to +37% YoY. Amazon separately in discussions to sell custom AI chips to challenge NVIDIA. Amazon also faces potential FTC lawsuit with billions in civil penalties over sponsored listings/reserve pricing practices. AWS expanded strategic collaboration with Kyndryl on agentic AI.
